messages:
lina (support): customer reported repeated failures when using strict JSON output. they call response_format=json and strict=true, but we're returning either invalid JSON or a 502 HTML error. they were charged for retries (~$0.12). repro below.

lina (support): repro curl they ran:
```bash
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -H 'Accept: text/html' 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-xl","prompt":"summarize...","response_format":"json","strict":true}'
```

lina (support): response they got (excerpt):
```
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8

<html>...internal gateway error...</html>
```

lina (support): customer says on our side the SDK retried 3x and each attempt was billed, so they got charged for the failed parse attempts. they want a refund + root cause.

maya (eng): can you paste the request-id / x-request-id from the customer response headers? also which model & region?

lina (support): request-id: req_abc12345, model: redwood-xl, region: us-west-2. timestamps: 2026-03-14T17:08:32Z (first).

jon (eng-oncall): looking quickly at logs for req_abc12345 — the generator returned an HTML error page from an upstream service during streaming chunk assembly while strict parsing was enabled. because the client sent Accept: text/html we didn't normalize the response to JSON-only mode; strict parser attempted to parse the HTML and failed (invalid JSON). SDK treats a parse failure as a retryable error and retried, which is why customer saw multiple billable attempts.

jon (eng-oncall): short term: advise customer to set Accept: application/json and retry with strict=true; that avoids ambiguous content negotiation. i'll open a ticket for an infra fix.

maya (eng): +1. we should also make response_format param authoritative (override Accept) for structured output enforcement. will spike a change to prefer explicit response_format over Accept header.

ricardo (billing): can support confirm invoice ids and exact timestamps? if SDK retries were automated and billed, we can issue a refund for the duplicate attempts once engineering confirms the retry behavior. please collect the 3 request-ids/timestamps and raise billing-adjustment ticket referencing acct AcmeCorp-42.

lina (support): noted. sending customer a safe workaround now (set Accept header & also set "strict": false if they need to get unblocked). asking if eng will prioritize a fix that prevents retries from billing in this class of parse-only failures.

maya (eng): plan: 1) treat response_format parameter as authoritative in the runtime router (PR in review), 2) change SDK retry policy to mark parse failures as non-idempotent until we can guarantee idempotency (hotfix), 3) add a metric & alert for "structured-output-parse-failures" so we catch regressions.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: infra/response-format-fix -> canary in 1h, full in 3h (deploy id dep-1848).

ricardo (billing): once eng confirms exact failure class and retried request-ids, i'll process billing adjustments.

lina (support): thanks — i'll update the customer and file the billing ticket with the ids. will bump if customer still sees issues after the header workaround. :white_check_mark:
